mapper.select: SELECT revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at FROM iam_revocation_fences WHERE revocation_request_id = #{revocationRequestId}

SELECT revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at FROM iam_revocation_fences WHERE target_type = 'TENANT' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND fence_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at FROM iam_revocation_fences WHERE target_type = 'MEMBERSHIP' AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND fence_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at FROM iam_revocation_fences WHERE target_type = 'IDENTITY' AND identity_id = #{identityId} AND fence_status = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO iam_revocation_fences (revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at) VALUES (#{row.revocationRequestId}, #{row.targetType}, #{row.targetId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.membershipId}, #{row.identityId}, #{row.fenceStatus}, #{row.establishedAt}, #{row.releasedAt}) RETURNING revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at

SELECT revocation_request_id, target_type, target_id, tenant_id, membership_id, identity_id, fence_status, established_at, released_at FROM iam_revocation_fences WHERE fence_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY target_type, target_id
